country_name: Gulf Cooperation Council (UAE, Saudi Arabia, etc.)
regulatory_bodies: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology (MoIAT)

requirements.title: Mandatory Bilingual Arabic Labelling
requirements.target_rule: GSO 9/2013 Clause 4.1 mandates that all mandatory labelling particulars (product name, ingredients, nutritional panel, expiry, origin, storage conditions) MUST be in Arabic. English may appear concurrently alongside Arabic.
requirements.indian_rule: Indian LMPC Rule 9 permits declarations in English or Hindi (in Devanagari script). Arabic is not recognized.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Provide complete Arabic translation of the label or apply a certified bilingual Arabic/English over-sticker.

requirements.title: Explicit Production & Expiration Dates (Gregorian)
requirements.target_rule: GSO 150-1/2013 strictly requires explicit Production Date AND Expiration Date in Day/Month/Year or Month/Year format (Gregorian calendar). Relative claims like 'Best Before 6 months from packaging' without explicit end dates are prohibited on many categories.
requirements.indian_rule: Indian LMPC permits declaration of 'Month and Year of Manufacture' or 'Best Before X months from manufacture'.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Print explicit Production Date (تاريخ الإنتاج) and Expiry Date (تاريخ انتهاء الصلاحية) in DD/MM/YYYY format.

requirements.title: Halal Compliance & Animal Derivation
requirements.target_rule: GSO 2055-1 strictly prohibits non-halal meat derivatives, pork/porcine ingredients (lard, porcine gelatin), and ethyl alcohol as an ingredient. Any gelatin or mono- and diglycerides (E471) must specify 100% plant or Halal-certified bovine origin.
requirements.indian_rule: FSSAI requires Green dot (Veg) or Brown dot (Non-Veg) symbol; specific halal certification is voluntary.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Ensure product is 100% Halal certified, free of alcohol and pork derivatives, and state vegetable/halal source for all emulsifiers and gelatin.

requirements.title: Prohibition of Fixed Indian MRP
requirements.target_rule: Prices are set freely by GCC retailers or monitored under local Ministry of Economy price-monitoring directives. Indian Rupee (₹) MRP printing is prohibited or invalid.
requirements.indian_rule: Mandatory Maximum Retail Price (MRP ₹ incl. of all taxes) under LMPC Rule 6(1)(e).
requirements.action_required_for_export: Remove Indian MRP markings. Pricing in AED/SAR is handled at local retail POS.

requirements.title: International System of Units (SI Metric)
requirements.target_rule: GSO 9 Clause 5.3 mandates the International System of Units (g, kg, ml, L) in Arabic numerals and Arabic script symbols.
requirements.indian_rule: SI metric units mandated under LMPC Rule 13.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Declare net weight/volume in metric units with Arabic unit symbols (e.g., غ for grams, مل for ml).

requirements.title: Country of Origin in Arabic
requirements.target_rule: GSO 9 Clause 5.8 requires the country of manufacture to be clearly stated in Arabic (e.g., 'صنع في الهند' - Made in India).
requirements.indian_rule: Country of origin in English or Hindi required.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Include 'صنع في الهند' (Made in India) prominently on the packaging.
